extraction.head: kafka-consumer-parallel-after

greptile.text: Describes a new thread-queue-parallel Kafka consumer mode using fixed per-group FIFO queues, with OffsetTracker, OrderedQueueWorker, FixedQueuePool, and SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy in queue_consumer.py, wired into ResultsStrategyFactory. Confidence score is 3/5, citing concurrency complexity, possible incorrect offset commits in OffsetTracker.commit_offset(), setdefault-based lock creation, and queue.ShutDown handling in workers.
Logic flag: the code catches queue.ShutDown, but the standard library queue module does not define that exception.
Logic flag: the standard library queue.Queue has no shutdown() method accepting an immediate parameter, so the q.shutdown(immediate=False) call is invalid.
